summary: Allocates and initializes per-lap session data. Resets the struct via StructResetReinitializer, sets mode flags (this+0xC = 2 and this+0x60 = 0 for session type dword_7C56A4 == 7, else 0 and 1), clears this+0x30, reads the lap count from dword_8ACF8C capped at 128 into this+0x88, allocates three arrays via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper (two 4*lapCount float arrays at this+0x8C and this+0x90, one lapCount byte array at this+0x94), records the count, and fills every element: both float arrays with int -1082130432 (float -1.0f sentinel) and the byte array with 0.

operations.description: Invoked per frame from SceneRenderUpdate (frame-path enabled).
StructResetReinitializer resets the struct state before allocation.
Clear this+0x30; then set this+0xC = 2 and this+0x60 = 0 when session type dword_7C56A4 == 7, otherwise this+0xC = 0 and this+0x60 = 1.
Read the lap count from dword_8ACF8C, cap at 128, and store into this+0x88.
Allocate three arrays via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper: 4 * this+0x88 floats at this+0x8C, 4 * this+0x88 floats at this+0x90, and this+0x88 bytes at this+0x94.
Record the element count at this+0x94 and zero this+0x98.
Initialize each of the this+0x88 entries: both float arrays (this+0x8C, this+0x90) get int -1082130432 (IEEE-754 float -1.0f sentinel) and the byte array (this+0x94) gets 0.
